class.name: chrono_remote_fmu_hw_interface/ChronoRemoteFmuSystemInterface
class.description: 분산 버전 (distributed version): owns the same velocity->torque control logic as chrono_ros2_control/ChronoFmuSystemInterface, but talks to a remote chrono_split_dynamics_node over ONE bridge (chrono_split_msgs VehicleCommand/VehicleStatus) instead of calling fmu_client locally -- meant to run with ros2_control on one PC while the FMU dynamics run on a separate PC.
